brand.name: ADVentura
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index. CORRECTION: the Mac folder is named 'Blue Eyed Jack,' but that is actually the LINE name ('Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge'), not the brand/company name. The brand is 'ADVentura,' made/distributed by ADV & McKay Cigars Co., founded 2016 by Henderson Ventura (of Tabacalera William Ventura) and Marcel Knobel (Swiss sommelier/coffee producer-retailer). Sold in Europe from 2017; US market debut ~2019 (IPCPR).
brand.origin_country: Dominican Republic (manufacture) - the company's own corporate HQ country is not stated in any source found.

line.name: ADVentura Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge
line.description: One line with a base blend plus a Maduro wrapper variant sub-named 'High Tide' - confirmed by Cigar Coop as 'adding a Maduro offering to the Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge line' (same binder/filler, different wrapper), not two separate lines. Uses a 'talking box' gimmick, also used on ADVentura's earlier Barbarroja's Invasion (2022). Made at Tabacalera Mina del Rey, co-founded by Ventura and Knobel in late 2023.
line.wrapper: Mexican San Andres Colorado (base blend); Mexican San Andres Maduro (High Tide variant)
line.filler: Dominican - one source (Cigar Coop) has an internal inconsistency, its own blend-summary box says 'Dominican filler' while its body text says 'aged Nicaraguan fillers'; 3 other sources (Cigar Inspector, The Cigar Authority, Neptune Cigar) say Dominican filler only. Recorded as Dominican with this one-source conflict flagged rather than silently resolved.
line.factory: Tabacalera Mina del Rey, Dominican Republic
line.status: current (base blend); limited/annual run (Maduro 'High Tide,' ~1,000 boxes/year)

vitolas.name: Corona
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. Shipped July 2024 (previewed PCA 2024). 20-ct box; $13.20/cigar, $264/box.

vitolas.name: Maduro High Tide (Diadema)
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. Single size, debuted PCA 2025 (April 2025), shipped June 2025, a 2nd installment was reported for ~2026. 10-ct box with a collectible pirate coin; $21/cigar, $210/box; limited to ~1,000 boxes/year.

research_notes: A 4th vitola, Toro (6x54, $15.00/cigar), exists in the base blend lineup per sourcing but has no matching Mac photo this batch, so not added. A Short Robusto (4x50) retailer-exclusive limited to 3,000 sticks was also found referenced (halfwheel tag page, title/summary only, full article not fetched) - not added, flagged as low-confidence/unconfirmed. Exact factory address/city for Tabacalera Mina del Rey not found in sources reviewed.
